calibration_rulings.title: ev.kafu-nights.intro, first sentence: singular or plural copula after the plural-form name «“کفو” کی راتیں».
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «“کفو” کی راتیں رمضان کا ایک سالانہ عوامی میلہ ہے۔» B would read as "these nights are a festival" (the literal nights); C adds «نامی» to a name N351 already marks and repeats «میلہ». Scope: this string; not a general rule on plural-form names.

calibration_rulings.title: ev.kafu-nights.intro: "in Al-Ahsa Governorate" («في محافظة الأحساء»).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A, by N92 and the fruits-page precedent; «الاحساء میں» stands before the university so the two names do not run together. Cost (the unit unnamed) charged under accuracy, as N92 accepts.

calibration_rulings.title: ev.kafu-nights.intro: "its first edition was held in 2024".
calibration_rulings.ruling: A'' (round 2, replacing A'): «یہ میلہ پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا۔» — the set collocation for a festival taking place; answers both readers with one word; the organiser keeps «منعقد کرتی ہے» (as ev.lomi.intro «… یہ نمائش منعقد کرتا ہے»). A (flat) and A' (the repetition, weighed and refused) withdrawn; B and C stay refused on stage 4's grounds.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the clause reads «پہلی بار 2024 میں لگا»; no noun for "edition".

calibration_rulings.title: ev.kafu-nights.intro: "community" (AR «مجتمعي») in "community festival".
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «عوامی» (open to the public), by the approved card precedent; the attestation gap is stated.
